spec.title: Kamiwaza · Tomo
spec.description: Is Tomo answering members, and how are its models and tools doing?

spec.title: Tomo
spec.description: The Extension's Ready condition, as the platform operator reports it

spec.title: Components
spec.description: Tomo pods ready against Tomo pods scheduled

spec.expr: count(kube_pod_status_ready{namespace="$namespace", condition="true"} == 1 and on (namespace, pod) kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension="$extension"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Dependencies down
spec.description: Tomo's own probes of its database, queue, object store, model platform, and sandbox

spec.title: Answered turns
spec.description: Member and task turns that finished in the time range

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) AS value FROM conversation_input WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') AND $__timeFilter(accepted_at)

spec.title: Failed turns
spec.description: Turns that ended in failure in the time range

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS value FROM conversation_input WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') AND $__timeFilter(accepted_at)

spec.title: Model call errors (1h)
spec.description: Share of model calls in the last hour that did not return an answer

spec.title: Tool failures (1h)
spec.description: First-party tool calls that failed, raised, timed out, or were abandoned in the last hour

spec.title: Models
spec.description: Every model Tomo called in the time range, from its model-call audit log

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_id, ''), 'Unattributed') AS model,
       string_agg(DISTINCT route, ', ') AS route,
       count(*) AS calls,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'ok') / count(*) AS success,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) / 1000.0 AS p50,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) / 1000.0 AS p95,
       COALESCE(sum(prompt_token_count), 0) AS input_tokens,
       COALESCE(sum(response_token_count), 0) AS output_tokens,
       100.0 * COALESCE(sum(prompt_cache_read_tokens), 0) / NULLIF(sum(prompt_token_count), 0) AS cached
  FROM llm_audit_event
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY calls DESC

defaults.noValue: No model calls in the time range

spec.title: Calls by model
spec.description: Model calls per interval

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_id, ''), 'Unattributed') AS metric, count(*) AS value
  FROM llm_audit_event
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Tokens by model
spec.description: Input plus output tokens per interval

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_id, ''), 'Unattributed') AS metric,
       sum(COALESCE(prompt_token_count, 0) + COALESCE(response_token_count, 0)) AS value
  FROM llm_audit_event
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Call latency p95 by model
spec.description: 95th percentile time for a successful model call

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), COALESCE(NULLIF(model_id, ''), 'Unattributed') AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) / 1000.0 AS value
  FROM llm_audit_event
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome = 'ok'
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Failures by reason
spec.description: Failed model calls per second by route and normalised reason, live from Tomo's metrics

spec.title: Failed model calls
spec.description: Failed calls by model, outcome, and error class

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_id, ''), 'Unattributed') AS model, outcome, COALESCE(error_class, '') AS error,
       count(*) AS calls, max(created_at) AS last_seen
  FROM llm_audit_event
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND outcome <> 'ok'
 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
 ORDER BY calls DESC

spec.title: Turns by model
spec.description: Member and task turns by the model that answered them

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_catalog_id, ''), NULLIF(model_deployment_id, ''), 'Default model') AS model,
       count(*) AS turns,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged'))
             / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed')), 0) AS success,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - started_at))
         FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) AS p50,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM completed_at - started_at))
         FILTER (WHERE status IN ('completed', 'salvaged')) AS p95,
       mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reasoning_effort) AS reasoning
  FROM conversation_input WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') AND $__timeFilter(accepted_at)
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY turns DESC

defaults.noValue: No turns in the time range

spec.title: Turn outcomes
spec.description: Finished turns per interval by outcome

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(accepted_at, $__interval, 0),
       CASE WHEN status IN ('completed', 'salvaged') THEN 'completed' ELSE status END AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
  FROM conversation_input WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') AND $__timeFilter(accepted_at) AND status IN ('completed', 'salvaged', 'failed', 'cancelled')
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Turns by agent
spec.description: Turns by the agent that ran them, in chat or as a scheduled task

spec.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(agent_name, 'Tomo') AS agent,
       CASE execution_mode WHEN 'interactive' THEN 'Chat' ELSE 'Task' END AS mode,
       count(*) AS turns,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed
  FROM conversation_input WHERE kind IN ('message', 'steer') AND $__timeFilter(accepted_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY turns DESC

defaults.noValue: No turns in the time range

spec.title: In progress
spec.description: Turns queued or running now

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM conversation_input WHERE status IN ('queued', 'claimed', 'running')

spec.title: Tools
spec.description: First-party tool calls in the time range by outcome, from Tomo's metrics

defaults.noValue: No tool calls in the time range

spec.title: Tool calls
spec.description: First-party tool calls per second by tool

spec.title: Tool failures
spec.description: Failed first-party tool calls per second by tool and outcome

spec.title: Connector tools
spec.description: Brokered calls to connector and external capability tools

spec.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name AS tool, capability,
       count(*) AS calls,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'executing') AS running,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM finished_at - created_at))
         FILTER (WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL) AS p95
  FROM capability_invocation_receipt
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY calls DESC

defaults.noValue: No connector tool calls in the time range

spec.title: Answer feedback
spec.description: Member votes on answers in the time range

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'up') AS "helpful",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE vote = 'down') AS "not helpful"
  FROM chat_answer_feedback
 WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

spec.title: CPU, % of limit
spec.description: Busiest container per Tomo component, as a share of its CPU limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_kamiwaza_ai_component) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="cpu"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_component) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_component) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension="$extension", label_kamiwaza_ai_component!=""}))

spec.title: Memory, % of limit
spec.description: Largest container per Tomo component, as a share of its memory limit

spec.expr: 100 * max by (label_kamiwaza_ai_component) ((sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", resource="memory"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_component) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_component) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension="$extension", label_kamiwaza_ai_component!=""}))

options.content:
**Is Tomo answering members, and how are its models and tools doing?**

- **Status** is the operator's view of the extension, Tomo's own dependency probes, and the last hour of model and tool failures.
- **Models** comes from Tomo's model-call audit log, so it names each model and keeps history across restarts. **Failures by reason** is live from Tomo's metrics, which carry the provider route but not the model.
- **Turns** are member and task requests. Duration runs from when a worker starts the turn to when it finishes.
- **Tools** counts first-party tools from Tomo's metrics, and connector tools from Tomo's capability receipts.

Metrics need `tomo/connect-tomo.sh`, which adds the scrape and the **Tomo database** datasource. That datasource reads only content-free columns: no message text, prompt, or member identity. It is bound to the Tomo install the script connected; run the script again after reinstalling Tomo.
